title: A Study to Evaluate Seroprevalence and Seroconversion of Antibodies to Adeno-Associated Virus (AAV) in Patients With Hemophilia A
brief_summary: To quantify the seroprevalence of antibodies to AAV5, AAV6, and AAV8 and the seroconversion rate over varying follow-up intervals in subjects with hemophilia A
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects diagnosed with Hemophilia A
* Subjects aged 18years or over at time of entry

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently participating in an interventional study of any investigational product, device or procedure.
* Subjects who have been previously treated with AAV vector gene therapy
